leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a component state variable to store input value using the useState hook
Implement an event handler function to update state when input changes
Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the shape of props for reusable controlled input components
Utilize the onChange event attribute to connect input elements to state update handlers
Construct controlled input components by binding the value attribute to state variables
Control form submission behavior by preventing default browser actions with event.preventDefault()
Access input values from state variables to display or process user data
Modify input behavior by applying conditional styling based on state values
Use the value attribute to implement input clearing functionality by resetting state to empty string
Implement validation logic by comparing current input values against defined criteria
Apply controlled input patterns to different HTML form elements (text, email, textarea)
Return structured JSX that includes both input elements and their associated state management logic
